title: Sylvester's four point problem for ball-convex bodies
summary: We investigate Sylvester's classical four-point problem for ball-convex bodies, where convex hulls are replaced by intersections of balls of a fixed radius $R$. We show that the Efron--Buchta identities persist in this framework, so that the distribution of the number of vertices of the $R$-ball-convex hull of $n$ uniform random points is determined by the moments of the volumes of the hulls of its subsamples, and vice versa.
